verdict.rationale: For machine payments, the docs state plainly that agent payments "land directly in your Stripe balance and settle in fiat. Metrics, reporting, and multi-currency payouts work the same as any other payment in Stripe," with refunds through the standard API. x402 settlements are recorded as ordinary PaymentIntents. ACS agent orders arrive as standard checkout.session.completed events and appear on the Transactions page, tagged and filterable by originating agent. Missing for 10: an explicit payout and reconciliation-report statement for the ACS (physical-goods) seller channel, which is only implied; GA status for agent_details attribution, which is still private preview; and independent or hands-on confirmation that agent payments reconcile in payout reports.
